svg.title: Agreement Module Current-State Architecture - Simplified
svg.desc: Simplified current-state architecture for the RACPad Agreement module showing the plain request flow from store associate browser through the BFF, enterprise API, backend services, and data/downstream integrations.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 58, 89) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
🧑‍💼 Store Associate Browser
RACPad Agreement app

div.style: color: rgb(92, 68, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
racpad_agreement BFF Lambda
(single Lambda, routes by operation:
price quote, item pricing, create agreement,
legal price check, customer search, etc.)

div.style: color: rgb(61, 26, 85) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Enterprise RAC API
routes each BFF call to the right backend

div.style: color: rgb(22, 74, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Get Price Quote
calculates rent, tax, initial payment

div.style: color: rgb(22, 74, 32) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Create Agreement
saves the new agreement

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Legal Limits Check
validates item price is legally allowed

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tax Calculation
calculates tax on the agreement

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(23, 58, 89) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PostgreSQL - RACDB
agreement, customer, inventory records

div.style: color: rgb(56, 36, 101) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Circuit breaker
stops calling a failing service instead of hanging

div.style: color: rgb(56, 36, 101) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Logs & tracing
CloudWatch + tracing for every request
